answer: My answer to sybils is Timelocked storage commitment with slashing — storage locked for a month, slashed if the data vanishes — which makes the sable of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents barely notice the check, because storage locked for a month, slashed if the data vanishes is something they already have; the kernel falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the forge of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
